mathematics.assertion_tested: Enumerate the full-root-span and one-dimensional quotient matrix families for connected balanced bipartite 0,+1,-1 matrices of rank g<=3, degrees 2 or 4, and n2=2g+2; quotient by row and column relabeling with exact automorphism weights
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact integers and modular ranks over 3 and 31
mathematics.conventions: Rows with degree two define an intrinsic graph of column roots. Retain orientations with t>=s; give a factor 1/2 when t=s. No sign switching is used as an isomorphism
non_claims: Execution alone does not prove completeness of the classification
This catalogue does not itself establish cancellation of any open kernel or BGS
